segments.say: Here's the point. Ask with What do, the animal, and eat. Answer with They eat, and the food. Where は ばしょ、What は なに だよ。

segments.subtitleEn: S or K? Listen. City, s! Cat, k! Ice, s! Cup, k! Your turn. City, cat, ice, cup.

segments.say: Let's move! Jump like a dolphin. Up and splash! Now, swim like a fish. Wiggle, wiggle. イルカジャンプ、それから さかなの およぎ！

segments.subtitleJa: きょうの ゴール。にほんの たべものが どこから きたか いおう。「この ぎゅうにゅうは ほっかいどうから。」 さんちを いおう。
segments.subtitleEn: Today's goal. Say where food in Japan is from. This milk is from Hokkaido.

segments.say: Milk. White and cold. Gulp, gulp! milk は ぎゅうにゅう。Milk!
segments.subtitleJa: milk。しろくて つめたい。ゴクゴク！ milk は「ぎゅうにゅう」。milk！
segments.subtitleEn: Milk. White and cold. Gulp, gulp! Milk!

segments.say: Orange. Round, juicy, and orange, too! Orange!
segments.subtitleJa: orange は「オレンジ」。まるくて、ジューシーで、いろも オレンジ！ orange！
segments.subtitleEn: Orange. Round, juicy, and orange, too! Orange!

segments.say: Potato. It grows under the ground. Dig, dig! potato は じゃがいも。Potato!
segments.subtitleJa: potato。つちの なかで そだつよ。ほって、ほって！ potato は「じゃがいも」。potato！
segments.subtitleEn: Potato. It grows under the ground. Dig, dig! Potato!

segments.say: Farmer. A person who grows food for us. Thank you, farmers! farmer は のうかの ひと。Farmer!
segments.subtitleJa: farmer。わたしたちの ために たべものを そだてる ひと。ありがとう、のうかの みなさん！ farmer は「のうかの ひと」。farmer！
segments.subtitleEn: Farmer. A person who grows food for us. Thank you, farmers! Farmer!

segments.say: Haru grabs a bottle. This milk is from Hokkaido. It's my favorite! Kiko lifts a big apple. These apples are from Aomori. They are huge!
segments.subtitleJa: ハルくんが びんを もって「この ぎゅうにゅうは ほっかいどうから。だいすき！」 キコちゃんが おおきな りんごを もちあげて「この りんごは あおもりから。すごく おおきい！」
segments.subtitleEn: Haru grabs a bottle. This milk is from Hokkaido. It's my favorite! Kiko lifts a big apple. These apples are from Aomori. They are huge!

slide.title: かいわ
items: This milk is from Hokkaido. It's my favorite!
These apples are from Aomori. They are huge!

segments.say: Riko asks, Where are these oranges from? I say, They are from Ehime. Many oranges grow there. えひめは みかんが ゆうめい だね。
segments.subtitleJa: リコちゃん「この オレンジは どこから きたの？」 わたし「えひめからよ。オレンジが たくさん そだつの。」 えひめは みかんが ゆうめい だね。
segments.subtitleEn: Riko asks, Where are these oranges from? I say, They are from Ehime. Many oranges grow there.

slide.title: かいわ
items: They are from Ehime. Many oranges grow there.

segments.say: Here's the point. One thing, use is. This milk is from Hokkaido. Many things, use are. These apples are from Aomori. ひとつは is、たくさんは are。
segments.subtitleJa: ポイント。ひとつの ものは is。This milk is from Hokkaido. たくさんの ものは are。These apples are from Aomori. ひとつは is、たくさんは are。
segments.subtitleEn: Here's the point. One thing, use is. This milk is from Hokkaido. Many things, use are. These apples are from Aomori.

segments.say: Sound time! G E at the end says j. Huge. Large. Stage. Orange. さいごの e は よまないよ。
segments.subtitleJa: おとの じかん！ おわりの ge は「ジ」。huge。large。stage。orange。さいごの e は よまないよ。
segments.subtitleEn: Sound time! G E at the end says j. Huge. Large. Stage. Orange.

segments.say: Blend it. h, u, ge, huge! st, a, ge, stage! A huge orange dances on the stage! Your turn. Huge, large, stage, orange.
segments.subtitleJa: つなげよう。h・u・ge で huge！ st・a・ge で stage！ おおきな オレンジが ステージで おどってる！ あなたの ばん。huge、large、stage、orange。
segments.subtitleEn: Blend it. h, u, ge, huge! st, a, ge, stage! A huge orange dances on the stage! Your turn. Huge, large, stage, orange.

segments.say: Let's move! Drink some milk. Ahh, yummy! Now, make a huge circle. Bigger, bigger! ぎゅうにゅうを のんで、おおきな まる！
segments.subtitleJa: からだを うごかそう！ ぎゅうにゅうを のんで。ぷはー、おいしい！ つぎは おおきな まるを つくって。もっと、もっと おおきく！ ぎゅうにゅうを のんで、おおきな まる！
segments.subtitleEn: Let's move! Drink some milk. Ahh, yummy! Now, make a huge circle. Bigger, bigger!

slide.title: からだで やってみよう

segments.say: Stand on the stage. Stand tall and smile! Now, peel an orange. Mmm, it smells so good!
segments.subtitleJa: ステージに たって。むねを はって にっこり！ つぎは オレンジの かわを むいて。んー、いい におい！
segments.subtitleEn: Stand on the stage. Stand tall and smile! Now, peel an orange. Mmm, it smells so good!

slide.title: からだで やってみよう

segments.say: Speed challenge! Peel an orange! Make a huge circle! Drink some milk! Stand on the stage! Make a huge circle! Great moves!

segments.subtitleEn: Speed challenge! Peel an orange! Make a huge circle! Drink some milk! Stand on the stage! Make a huge circle! Great moves!

segments.subtitleEn: Where are these oranges from?

segments.say: Quiz time! Many apples. Which is right? A, These apples are from Aomori. Or B, These apples is from Aomori. どっちかな？

segments.subtitleEn: Quiz time! Many apples. Which is right? A, These apples are from Aomori. Or B, These apples is from Aomori.

segments.say: It's A! Many apples, so we say are. These apples are from Aomori. Super job! たくさんは are だね。

segments.subtitleEn: It's A! Many apples, so we say are. These apples are from Aomori. Super job!
